note: Names, descriptions, grades and PSN counts are the official list as tracked by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Guides are written in our own words for this entry from the official descriptions and the published guides cited per trophy. The game launched 19 Nov 2026, so methods marked not yet confirmed are still being pinned down by guide writers; check the cited guides for updates.

sixshore.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are yours — there is no extra step. Plan on roughly 200 hours (PowerPyx) in a single playthrough; nothing here needs online play or DLC. The long pole is A Long Road, the 100% checklist, so treat this as the finish line, not a task of its own.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission of Chapter 1, and it pops when the mission ends. Nothing to prepare — just play the intro.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Play through Chapter 1 to its end. PowerPyx notes chapter trophies can pop a little late, after the first mission or two of the next chapter, so do not worry if it does not fire the instant the chapter closes.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Play through Chapter 2 to its end. Like the other chapter trophies it can pop a little late, once you are a mission or two into the next chapter.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Play through Chapter 3 to its end. It marks the point where several new systems open up — the Snap Gun, the dye pack jammer and Randy's strand among them — so expect a batch of new trophy options right after it.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Play through Chapter 4 to its end. Bank jobs open through an optional mission in this chapter, so once it pops, the vault trophies are on the table.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The final mission's trophy — finish the story's last mission and the gold pops. It is the only gold story trophy, and it marks the point where free roam opens up fully and the 100% completion checklist appears, so the cleanup stages start here.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the main mission Breakfast Run and it pops when the mission ends. There is no mission replay in GTA 6, but story trophies cannot be missed — they fire automatically when you finish the mission.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the main mission The Cartel Heist and it pops when the mission ends. Heist missions are where the big paydays start, which feeds the money trophies later.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the main mission Child's Play and it pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the main mission Headliners and it pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the main mission VCIA Takedown and it pops when the mission ends. The airport is also the stage for Catch Me If You Can, so you will be back at VCIA for that one.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the main mission Operation Savage Glory and it pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the completion checklist, which appears after the story under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion. PowerPyx calls the checklist lenient — closer to 60% of true completion: you need 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 18 meditation spots and 300 stunts, plus all 8 bank vaults, all 39 gang operations, every shooting range, every drone race and every Bret quest. Most of it comes from doing the other trophies. Save this for last; it is the hardest trophy and the final step before the platinum.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 stunts. PowerPyx counts 397 in the world across four kinds: 130 stunt jumps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights and base jumps. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250 — the extra 50 count toward A Long Road. Stunt progress is tracked in your stats, so check there to see what is left.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. PowerPyx lists them as fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt. One try each is enough — you do not need to win or finish anything. Tick them off as you meet them during the story and the activities stage.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Ranges are one of the 9 activity types, so a visit also counts toward Master of None. Gold medals are per challenge, so you can chip away at them one range at a time; your best medal per challenge is what counts.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. You need a win at each spot, not just a finish — repeat a location until you take first. Races are quick, so treat this as a tour of the map's race spots.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each race only counts once, so range across the map and across race types instead of replaying one favourite. Your race wins are tracked in stats, so check there before hunting for the last few.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. You meet Cal in Chapter 1, and he texts you a fishing spot afterwards — take the challenge there and out-fish him. Fishing is also one of the 9 activity types for Master of None, so this visit does double duty.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game — play any in-game video game through to the end. Three run on the TV at home and a fourth sits on arcade machines, so pick whichever you like. Finishing one game is enough; you do not need a high score.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Her strand is Lucia-only and starts with a phone call in Chapter 3 — answer it and follow the strand to its last mission. Side strands stay available after the story, so this cannot be missed.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton — his treasure-diving strand, 7 shipwrecks in total. Kenton goes quiet after Chapter 1 and returns later, so do not worry if he disappears for a while; the strand is not missable.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy at the mud club in Kelly County. His strand opens in Chapter 2 — follow it through to the end.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only some side questlines count toward the 8, and PowerPyx is still confirming which ones — the contact strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) are the natural candidates. You can finish strands after the story, so keep taking stranger missions as they appear.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy — his wish list of 16 sports cars. The strand opens in Chapter 3. Source the cars he asks for and deliver them; the final mission pops once the list is done.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone by shutting down labs in Vice City. His strand is Jason-only and starts in Chapter 3.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 marked spots. This is the one possibly missable trophy in the game. During Chapter 1, one morning at Jason's house, Lucia says she is going to meditate and walks out to the balcony. Follow her, accept the optional quest and do the meditation — it is gone after Chapter 1, and PowerPyx reports it raises the meditation counter even though it is not marked as a spot like the other 18, so it is unclear whether the trophy needs it. Do it when it comes up; it takes a minute and removes the risk. The 100% checklist only needs 15 of the 18 spots.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. His strand is Jason-only and opens in Chapter 2. PowerPyx has not yet confirmed which animal triggers it — clearing all 15 of Bret's target decks, which the 100% checklist needs anyway, should cover it.

trophies.name: Don’t Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets out of 18 in the game. Cards are scattered across Leonida; finish any 3 sets and the silver pops. The 100% checklist wants 15 of the 18 sets, so keep collecting past 3.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations — scan landmarks, curiosities and sculptures with the WAiNK phone app. Keep the app handy while exploring and scan as you go; the counter ticks up with each new spot. It pairs well with exploring for The Goodtime State, since both reward covering the map.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges out of 80. Challenges cover everything from stunts to robberies, so this builds as you play. The 100% checklist needs 70, so treat 50 as the halfway mark, not the finish.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. It becomes possible once both characters can roam together in Chapter 2. Bank jobs hand you 4 stars anyway, so try it during a job — then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars clear.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. You can only start once character switching unlocks, after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. Keep the wanted level alive between shops and do not let it drop; PowerPyx notes the trophy pops about 30 seconds after you leave the third shop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning them with the WAiNK app is enough — you do not have to drive them. Scan every new vehicle you see; the 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models scanned, so this comes early on the way to that.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. PowerPyx reports gang members count, while soldiers, police and civilians seem not to — so pick a gang fight, trigger Combat Focus with a group clustered together, and drop five before it ends.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA: steal a passenger jet docked at a gate at Vice City International Airport and fly about 1 km away. Get aboard, get it moving and get clear of the airport — the trophy is about the getaway, not a destination.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos — steal a military tank. PowerPyx found tanks at Mile Zero Air Station in the southwest. Expect a heavy response once you are in it; getting the tank is the hard part, keeping it is the fun part.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. You need the Snap Gun, which a Chapter 3 main mission gives you — so this opens in Chapter 3 at the earliest. Go in quiet, take what you came for and leave before anyone raises the alarm.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Bank jobs open through an optional mission in Chapter 4, and there are 8 vaults in total — the 100% checklist needs all 8, so plan on more than 5. Each vault is a full job: get in, crack it, get out.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The first bank job counts for this, or you can blow open a truck's back door with a sticky bomb earlier in the game. Either way, grab the cash and break away clean.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — clear the fog from the entire map. A plane is the fastest way to sweep the corners; drive or fly through every area until the map is fully revealed. It pairs with the WAiNK and vehicle scans, so explore with the app out.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. One per gang is enough for the trophy; the 100% checklist wants all 39 operations, so you will be revisiting gangs later anyway.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The exact method is not yet confirmed by guide writers — head to the Ocean Beach waterfront, find a bar with a view and order a drink. Marked not yet confirmed: check the cited guides for updates as the method is pinned down.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The exact method is not yet confirmed — find a vehicle showroom, get inside a car and drive it out through the glass. Marked not yet confirmed; see the cited guides as writers confirm the spot.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley — take all 3 key valuables from the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn. The robbery comes back later if you miss anything, so it is not missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal — max out strength on both Jason and Lucia. Work out together and both make progress; keep training until both hit the cap. Note: Push Square does not mark this one as hidden, while PSNProfiles and TrueTrophies do.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse — do 500 things that change your Criminal Profile. One guide (GTABase, as reported in the Sixshore roundup) puts the count at 500; it comes naturally across a full playthrough, so do not grind it — check your profile progress in stats and let it build. Note: the 500 figure is single-source and unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The method is not yet confirmed — PowerPyx suspects a link to a Payday Loans store. Marked not yet confirmed; watch the cited guides for the confirmed method.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? The method is not yet confirmed — PowerPyx suspects a UFO questline. Marked not yet confirmed; this one looks like an easter egg hunt, so expect the method to surface as players map it.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Not yet confirmed — the in-game hint points to a melee attack from a moving vehicle, and PowerPyx suspects a kick from a motorcycle. Try a melee strike from a moving bike and watch for the pop.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies, and the total adds up across jobs. The dye pack jammer — needed to handle them — unlocks in a Chapter 3 main mission, so this is a post-Chapter 3 earner.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos get you there fastest — and spending is part of playing anyway, so this usually pops during the cleanup stages without a dedicated grind.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. PowerPyx puts the total at about $160,000, and the real estate app arrives in Chapter 2. Garages also give you the space On the Spot needs, so buy them before registering vehicles.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. You need garage space first, so pair it with Little Boxes — buy the garages, then register ten vehicles from your collection.
